record_title: Exact coloring-channel capacity via trace monoids
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. The producing agent identified the coloring-channel output quotient with a classical trace/history monoid and applied established trace-growth theory; see RESULT.md and SELF_AUDIT.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical trace/history-monoid theory is prior art; the claimed contribution is its application to coloring-channel capacity. The full Shields 1985 article was subscription-inaccessible in this run, and a contemporaneous or poorly indexed 2026 note could independently contain the same application. No independent validation is asserted.
